title: Saved official filings and hearing records
adds: A source library of saved agency filings, congressional hearings and other official records. Each record keeps its date, issuer, source type and limits. These are records, not proof that a proposal became law or an announcement became delivery.

summary_role: Exact saved study bottom line; object-local evidence date retained.
